awards.text: Ease of Doing Business assessment (DIPP): AP joint 1st with Telangana (98.78% implementation).
Swachh Survekshan 2017 (MoHUA): Visakhapatnam 3rd cleanest of 434 cities; Tirupati 9th; Vijayawada 19th.
Ease of Doing Business (BRAP 2017-18): AP ranked 1st among all states.
Ease of Doing Business (BRAP 2019): AP 1st again.
Swachh Survekshan 2021 (conferred by the President): Vijayawada 3rd cleanest big city; Tirupati Platinum 'Prerak Daaur Samman'; Vijayawada 5-star Garbage Free.
Ease of Doing Business (BRAP 2020): AP among the 7 'Top Achievers'.
Swachh Survekshan 2022: Tirupati best city in Safai Mitra Suraksha; Visakhapatnam and Tirupati 5-star Garbage Free.
4th National Water Awards (Jal Shakti): AP joint 3rd Best State; KGBV School Chagalamarri (Nandyal) 2nd Best School; CCL Products (Tirupati) joint 3rd Best Industry.
5th National Water Awards (conferred by the President): Visakhapatnam district — Best District, South Zone.
Swachh Survekshan 2024-25 (conferred by the President): Visakhapatnam (GVMC) — Best SafaiMitra Surakshit Shehar.
National Panchayat Awards 2025 (Panchayati Raj Ministry): 5 awards to AP — incl. Srungavaram GP (Visakhapatnam) 1st for Good Governance (₹1 Cr) and Kuppam Block Panchayat 3rd Best Block.
